neutral.label: Neutral Celan
neutral.voice: Balanced, readable, and not strongly tied to one national voice.
neutral.courtesy: Celan keeps the phrasing direct, and politeness is carried more by restraint than by piling on extra words.

verdalrisian.label: Verdalrisian
verdalrisian.voice: Lyrical, patient, and guided by natural imagery.
verdalrisian.courtesy: This lens prefers guiding language and living metaphors over blunt force.

pelagaean.label: Pelagaean
pelagaean.courtesy: This lens prefers flow-language and soft relational movement rather than hard confrontation.

zarithan.label: Zarithan
zarithan.courtesy: This lens cuts ornament and keeps only what the moment needs.

valkeldorian.label: Valkeldorian
valkeldorian.courtesy: This lens tolerates harder edges if they sound resolute and controlled.

mechuman.label: Mechuman
mechuman.courtesy: This lens trims emotional spillover and favors clear functional phrasing.

nivveilian.label: Nivveilian
nivveilian.voice: Sparse, patient, and cool in emotional temperature.
nivveilian.courtesy: This lens often softens intensity through restraint rather than through more words.

jasaran.label: Jasaran
jasaran.courtesy: This lens seeks equilibrium between firmness and beauty.

marakorian.label: Marakorian
marakorian.courtesy: This lens leans ceremonial and proper rather than casual.

blessings.title: Blessings
blessings.cues: Blessings, parting words, spiritual goodwill, and elevated hopes for another person.
blessings.notes: Celan blessings often lean on peace, path, light, guidance, or hopeful invocation rather than flat statements.

examples.english: May peace be on your path.

longing.title: Longing
longing.cues: Longing, yearning, desire, intimate wanting, and heart-pulled expression.
longing.notes: This family often spreads across heart, desire, yearning, and nearness rather than one narrow English-style want-word.

time_questions.title: Time Questions
time_questions.cues: Questions about time, timing, sequence, and the present moment.
time_questions.notes: Time questions are their own phrase family. The support is real, but the exact current-time question remains thin in the canon-facing material.

examples.english: I seek peace in the balance of time.
I will go to the city / I go in time-setting toward the city.
I drink the water at noon.

boundaries.title: Boundaries
boundaries.cues: Commands, refusals, distancing language, personal limits, and pushing something away.
boundaries.notes: English idioms in this family often need reshaping into distance, refusal, or removal language.

examples.english: I do not go without shoes.

affection.title: Affection
affection.cues: Affection, care, love, emotional closeness, and warmly directed feeling.
affection.notes: Affection may move through connection, heart, or presence rather than only blunt declaration.

requests.title: Requests
requests.cues: Requests, asks, polite instructions, and formal or practical inquiries.
requests.notes: A request is not always a command. Celan can carry asking, directing, or inviting differently.

examples.english: Do you speak the price of the food?

movement_direction.title: Movement and Direction
movement_direction.cues: Going, heading, guiding, arriving, traveling, and path-centered phrasing.
movement_direction.notes: Movement is one of the clearest structural centers of Celan.

truth_speaking.title: Truth-Speaking
truth_speaking.cues: Truth, honesty, declaration, moral speech, and aligned speech.
truth_speaking.notes: Truth in Celan often reaches beyond bare fact into right naming, order, and moral alignment.

grief_and_fear.title: Grief and Fear
grief_and_fear.cues: Fear, grief, dread, sorrow, despair, loss, and burdened feeling.
grief_and_fear.notes: Celan often ties grief to darkness, time, or the heart rather than isolating emotion into a separate grammar.
